avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet effects increase bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or limit Vitamin E to <400 IU/day; monitor for bleeding signs

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet properties combined with NSAID increase hemorrhage risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue ginkgo biloba during piroxicam therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic (therapeutic doses)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects increase GI and systemic bleeding
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; culinary amounts are acceptable

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Both have anti-inflammatory properties; potential for additive GI irritation
caution_supplements.action: Use together cautiously; monitor for GI symptoms; may allow lower NSAID doses

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Can cause sodium retention and fluid accumulation, increasing hypertension and edema risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and fluid status; limit duration of concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Fish oil (omega-3)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; may have additive anti-inflammatory benefit
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for bruising or bleeding; generally safe at moderate doses (2-3g/day)

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol (≥3 drinks daily)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Synergistic GI ulceration and bleeding risk; increased hepatotoxicity
avoid_foods.action: Strictly limit alcohol intake; counsel on GI bleed warning signs (dark stools, hematemesis)

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay piroxicam absorption and increase peak plasma levels; potential GI upset
caution_foods.action: Take piroxicam with food to minimize GI irritation; separate from high-fat meals if possible

caution_foods.name: Excessive sodium intake
caution_foods.mechanism: NSAIDs impair sodium handling; high intake increases fluid retention and hypertension risk
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate salt restriction; monitor blood pressure and edema

caution_foods.name: Potassium-rich foods (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal potassium excretion; hyperkalemia risk with excessive intake
caution_foods.action: Monitor potassium levels in high-risk patients (renal disease, elderly); counsel on moderation

monitoring_notes: Piroxicam has a long half-life (~50 hours), increasing cumulative interaction risk. Monitor for GI bleeding, renal function decline, hypertension, and edema; check baseline renal function, CBC, and electrolytes before therapy and periodically during use.
